For workflow/operator proof, default to a landscape board with five compact step tiles; use portrait only for quote/stat-led posters. landing-hero.job_to_be_done: Create a deployable landing-page hero background/sidecar animation that sits next to a separate one-line title and communicates the product category in 2-3 seconds.

exact_text_policy.guidance: Do not render hero headline, nav, CTA, labels, CLI, or body copy inside the native video. Place exact title/body/CTA in the webpage/HTML overlay outside the generated animation.

landing-hero.prompt_skeleton: Generate only the 16:9 animated hero visual plate, not a full webpage. Reserve calm negative space for a separate one-line title beside or above the media; no nav, headline, CTA, footer, or readable page copy inside the video. Use one product-grounded motion metaphor (capability artifacts, workflow cards, manifests, tools, or approved UI proof moving into an agent/runtime) with a slow parallax/reveal/settle and a poster-worthy final hold. Keep it loopable, muted, and lightweight for web hero use.
negative_prompt_failure_bans: full hero section mockup with nav/headline/CTA
complete webpage screenshot or browser chrome
readable native video text, labels, CLI, or footer copy
fake dashboards, fake app screens, or invented UI taxonomy
generic purple Web3 crystal/coin hero unless the brand explicitly calls for it
particle explosions, random camera spins, or stock intro-template effects
logo-only animation with no product/workflow meaning
social-card/poster layout instead of landing-page hero media
review_focus: deployable hero-background/sidecar animation asset, not a full webpage
external copy safe space with no native video text
single purposeful motion idea and final hold
web delivery fit: 16:9 MP4 primary, optional WebM alternate, muted loop, reduced-motion poster fallback
brand recognition without defaulting to generic purple Web3 art

web_delivery.html_usage: <video autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="metadata" poster="..."> with exact hero copy rendered outside the video; respect prefers-reduced-motion with a poster/static fallback.

system-explainer-illustration.job_to_be_done: Create a mechanism-led Sage explainer illustration that makes one real product/protocol workflow legible at a glance.

exact_text_policy.guidance: If exact visible copy, numbers, quotes, event details, command text, or UI labels matter, use html/svg/composite/typographic overlay; do not trust native image text.

system-explainer-illustration.prompt_skeleton: Explain one concrete Sage mechanism as a simple visual system: source artifact or manifest, routing/verification step, default capability slot, and finished downstream outcome. Use 2-4 large shapes, one directional flow, and generous negative space. Prefer a fresh source-derived framing not used recently: selection sieve, fat-skills/thin-harness layer, tokenized-taste canon, execution DAG compounds, RLM memory loop, category constellation, flat diagrams, shelves, maps, lattice paths, abstract capability artifacts, or proof sheets. Do not default to generic switchboard/hub or robots/humanoid agents unless explicitly requested. Avoid generic metaphor collages and fake dashboards. If labels matter, reserve them for deterministic overlay.
negative_prompt_failure_bans: ambient brand world with no mechanism
abstract metaphor that hides the product flow
defaulting to semi-realistic robot/humanoid agent scenes unless requested
defaulting to central hub/switchboard composition with characters pushing artifacts inward unless requested
invented capabilities not grounded in references or approved product truth
review_focus: one causal mechanism visible at a glance
real product/protocol truth instead of invented taxonomy
simple system structure and directional flow
